description: Defines a SwiftUI View component 'ConfigSettings' to manage and display configuration settings, including sections, subsections, and schema-driven forms with reload/save actions.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view for configuration settings interface with sections and schema-driven forms.

classes.name: ConfigSettings.SubsectionSelection
classes.description: Enum representing selected subsection, either all or a specific key.

classes.name: ConfigSettings.ConfigSection
classes.description: Struct representing a configuration section with key, label, help text, and schema node.

classes.name: ConfigSettings.ConfigSubsection
classes.description: Struct representing a subsection within a config section, with key, label, help, node, and path.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Computes and returns the list of configuration sections based on current schema.

methods.name: activeSection
methods.description: Determines the currently active section based on activeSectionKey.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar view listing all sections and subsections.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Constructs the detail view showing schema form or status.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Displays message when no section is selected.

methods.name: sectionDetail
methods.description: Displays detailed view of selected section including schema form and actions.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Header section with title and instructions.

methods.name: sectionHeader
methods.description: Displays label and help for a specific section.

methods.name: actionRow
methods.description: Row with reload and save buttons for config.

methods.name: sidebarSection
methods.description: View for a collapsible section in sidebar, with subsections.

methods.name: sidebarSubRow
methods.description: View for a subsection item in sidebar.

methods.name: sectionForm
methods.description: Generates the schema-driven form for a section.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures an active section is selected.

methods.name: ensureSubsection
methods.description: Ensures an active subsection is selected within a section.

methods.name: selectSection
methods.description: Sets the active section and defaults to first subsection.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts sections based on schema and hints.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts subsections for a section.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves the effective schema node, handling 'anyOf' and 'oneOf'.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts underscore/hyphenated keys into human-readable strings.
